issue: Does the government's mandatory detention of an alien under 8 U.S.C. § 1225 or § 1226 pending removal proceedings, rather than bond-eligible detention, apply to this petitioner?

sides.position: This court (2d Cir.) holds the petitioner's detention is governed by the statute the panel applied and that habeas relief was properly granted; the excerpts do not identify the circuits on the opposing side.
cases: Barbosa Da Cunha v. Freden, No. 25-3141 (2d Cir. 2026)

this_court: The panel's reading of § 1225 is correct, and the district court had authority to grant habeas relief.
quote: Further, there is a deep and widening circuit split on the nationally important issue of whether the government may detain aliens like Petitioner under Section 1225 or Section 1226.
cite: Barbosa Da Cunha v. Freden, No. 25-3141 (2d Cir. 2026)
